from collections import deque, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
import pandas as pd

WIN, EPOCH, ZERO = timedelta(minutes=2), datetime(2025, 1, 1), Decimal("0")

def win_of(t):
    """Epoch-aligned tumbling window start."""
    s = (t - EPOCH).total_seconds()
    return EPOCH + timedelta(seconds=(s // WIN.total_seconds()) * WIN.total_seconds())

# ============================================================================
# ACCUMULATOR: keyed by (product_id, window_start); supports upsert + retract
# Emits canonical changelog rowkinds: +I (insert), -U/+U (update), -D (delete)
# ============================================================================
@dataclass
class KeyedAccumulator:
    state: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # key -> Decimal (authoritative total)
    changelog: list = field(default_factory=list)  # row-level changelog records
    log: list = field(default_factory=list)        # per-event summary

    def get(self, k):
        return self.state.get(k, ZERO)

    def _apply(self, key, after, event_id, note):
        before = self.get(key)
        if after == before:
            return                                  # no-op: idempotent
        if after == ZERO:
            self.state.pop(key, None)               # -D retires the key entirely
        else:
            self.state[key] = after
        recs = ([("+I", after)] if before == ZERO else
                [("-D", before)] if after == ZERO else
                [("-U", before), ("+U", after)])
        for rk, v in recs:
            self.changelog.append(dict(event_id=event_id, pid=key[0], window=key[1],
                                       rowkind=rk, value=v, before=before,
                                       after=after, note=note))
        self.log.append(dict(event_id=event_id, pid=key[0], window=key[1],
                             delta=after - before, before=before, after=after,
                             rowkinds=" ".join(r for r, _ in recs), note=note))

    def upsert(self, key, delta, event_id, note="upsert"):
        """Add delta to key (delta<0 is a legitimate negative sale)."""
        self._apply(key, self.get(key) + delta, event_id, note)

    def retract(self, key, amount, event_id, note="retract"):
        """Remove `amount` from key as an explicit correction."""
        self._apply(key, self.get(key) - amount, event_id, note)

# ============================== input (deduped) =============================
records = [
    (1,  "evt-003", "P3", "7.25",   "2025-01-01T00:02:00Z"),
    (2,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),
    (3,  "evt-007", "P1", "-10.00", "2025-01-01T00:06:00Z"),   # correction / retraction
    (4,  "evt-002", "P2", "25.50",  "2025-01-01T00:01:15Z"),
    (5,  "evt-005", "P2", "4.99",   "2025-01-01T00:04:05Z"),
    (6,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),   # duplicate (dropped by PK)
    (7,  "evt-004", "P1", "12.00",  "2025-01-01T00:03:20Z"),
    (8,  "evt-010", "P3", "21.10",  "2025-01-01T00:08:55Z"),
    (9,  "evt-006", "P3", "8.75",   "2025-01-01T00:05:10Z"),
    (10, "evt-009", "P3", "3.50",   "2025-01-01T00:07:30Z"),
    (11, "evt-011", "P2", "6.40",   "2025-01-01T00:09:40Z"),
    (12, "evt-008", "P2", "15.00",  "2025-01-01T00:06:45Z"),
]
tsf = lambda s: datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)

raw = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["arrival", "event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "t"])
raw["event_time"] = raw["t"].map(tsf)
raw["revenue"]    = raw["revenue"].map(Decimal)
raw = raw.drop(columns="t").sort_values("arrival").reset_index(drop=True)
deduped = raw.drop_duplicates("event_id", keep="first").reset_index(drop=True)

# ================= process: positives upsert; negatives RETRACT (FIFO) ======
acc = KeyedAccumulator()
open_pos = defaultdict(deque)     # pid -> deque[[event_id, key, remaining_amount]]
links = []

for r in deduped.itertuples():
    pid, rev, eid = r.product_id, r.revenue, r.event_id
    if rev > 0:
        key = (pid, win_of(r.event_time))
        acc.upsert(key, rev, eid, note="sale")
        open_pos[pid].append([eid, key, rev])
    elif rev < 0:
        remaining = -rev
        while remaining > 0 and open_pos[pid]:
            t_eid, t_key, avail = open_pos[pid][0]
            take = min(remaining, avail)
            acc.retract(t_key, take, eid, note=f"retract {t_eid}")
            links.append(dict(retractor=eid, target=t_eid, product_id=pid,
                              target_window=t_key[1], amount=take))
            open_pos[pid][0][2] -= take
            remaining -= take
            if open_pos[pid][0][2] == 0:
                open_pos[pid].popleft()
        if remaining > 0:                      # no positive left to match
            acc.upsert((pid, win_of(r.event_time)), -remaining, eid, note="unmatched neg")

# ================================ output ====================================
wfmt = lambda w: f"{w.strftime('%H:%M')}–{(w + WIN).strftime('%H:%M')}"

print("RETRACTION LINKS".center(96, "="))
print(pd.DataFrame(links).assign(amount=lambda d: d.amount.map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}"),
                                 target_window=lambda d: d.target_window.map(wfmt))
      .to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "PER-EVENT ACCUMULATOR LOG".center(96, "="))
print(pd.DataFrame(acc.log).assign(
    window=lambda d: d.window.map(wfmt),
    before=lambda d: d.before.map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}"),
    after=lambda d: d.after.map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}"),
    delta=lambda d: d.delta.map(lambda x: f"{x:+.2f}"),
).to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "CHANGELOG (retract/upsert stream)".center(96, "="))
print(pd.DataFrame(acc.changelog).assign(
    window=lambda d: d.window.map(wfmt),
    value=lambda d: d.value.map(lambda x: f"{x:+.2f}"),
)[["event_id", "pid", "window", "rowkind", "value", "note"]].to_string(index=False))

# --------------------- final state as product × window pivot ----------------
state_df = pd.DataFrame([dict(product_id=k[0], window=k[1], revenue=v)
                         for k, v in acc.state.items()])
pivot = (state_df.pivot_table(index="product_id", columns="window",
                              values="revenue", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=ZERO)
                 .sort_index(axis=1))
pivot.columns = [wfmt(c) for c in pivot.columns]
print("\nFINAL TOTAL REVENUE PER PRODUCT PER WINDOW".center(96, "="))
print(pivot.map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}").to_string())
print(f"{'ROW TOTALS':>12}  " + "  ".join(f"{p}={v:.2f}" for p, v in pivot.astype(float).sum(axis=1).items()))
print(f"{'GRAND TOTAL':>12}  {pivot.sum().sum():.2f}")
